responsibility: This definition file is the master table of HSAIL/BRIG-specific builtins recognized by GCC’s HSA frontend and backend support. It enumerates work-item and work-group query operations, BRIG opcode/type mappings, saturated arithmetic forms, conversion helpers, and HSA runtime intrinsics, together with their builtin enum names, user-visible symbols, GCC builtin type signatures, and attributes. Its role is declarative: other code includes it with different DEF_HSAIL_* macros to generate builtin registration, typing, and lowering logic for HSA BRIG compilation.
